bio: British chef Simon Scott worked his way from London to Provence, before setting up shop here in the Tarn département. The vivid red façade leads diners into a vibrant and cosy pop-inspired decor. This eclectic chef and master craftsman works exclusively with good-quality (local) ingredients, in a bid to serve his guests precise, colourful and tasty dishes, such as just-seared bluefin tuna, flame-burnt aubergine caviar, quinoa with three vegetables and shellfish broth with Middle Eastern spices. This Bistrot des Saveurs is certainly aptly named!...
